name: shipment_status
description: in_transit or delivered as of the snapshot.

name: shipped_timestamp
description: When the parcel left the warehouse (UTC); >= order_timestamp.

name: promised_delivery_date
description: Delivery date promised at checkout = order_date + 5 days.

name: delivered_timestamp
description: Set if and only if shipment_status = 'delivered'; must be >= shipped_timestamp.
